headline: Zero-ad, single-file 8-ball pool in your browser
text:
Need an 8-ball pool fix without downloading an app or watching ads?

Built Break Room: realistic cue ball spin, called pockets, and AI in a single HTML file. Loads instantly.

Rack 'em up:
https://kreeda.games/break-room/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second clean looping GIF/video showing a high-skill draw shot (backspin) using the cue spin pad to sink the 8-ball into a called corner pocket.
